blogs.title: Digging for Digital Gold: How DeepSeekMath Built a Massive Math Dataset from Scratch
blogs.description: This post will explore the data engineering behind the DeepSeekMath Corpus. It will detail the iterative pipeline used to extract 120 billion high-quality mathematical tokens from Common Crawl, explaining how the team used fastText classifiers and human annotation to filter noise and ensure data quality.

blogs.title: Beyond PPO: How GRPO is Revolutionizing Reinforcement Learning for AI
blogs.description: Focusing on the algorithmic contribution of the paper, this post will explain Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). It will break down how this method improves upon standard PPO by eliminating the need for a critic model, thereby reducing memory usage and training costs while boosting mathematical reasoning capabilities.

blogs.title: Does Coding Make You Better at Math? Surprising Lessons from DeepSeekMath
blogs.description: This post will dive into the paper's ablation studies regarding pre-training data. It will discuss the finding that training on code significantly improves mathematical reasoning (both with and without tools) and the counter-intuitive discovery that training on ArXiv papers showed no notable improvements on math benchmarks.

blogs.title: Small Model, Big Brains: How DeepSeekMath 7B Rivals GPT-4 in Math
blogs.description: This article will focus on the performance achievements of DeepSeekMath. It will analyze how a relatively small 7B parameter model, initialized from a code model and trained on high-quality data, can outperform massive models like Minerva 540B and approach the performance of proprietary giants like GPT-4.
